# NoiseMeters

> > NoiseMeters provides sound level meters, noise dosimeters, and monitoring systems for occupational, environmental, and industrial noise measurement with OSHA, MSHA, and NIOSH compliance.

NoiseMeters Inc is a North American supplier of professional noise measurement equipment and services, with offices in Michigan and Texas. The company specializes in portable and networked noise monitoring solutions for workplace safety, environmental surveys, and industrial applications.

## Key Topics

- Sound Level Meters
- Noise Dosimeters
- doseBadge
- LiveNoise
- OSHA Compliance
- Occupational Noise
- Environmental Monitoring

- MSHA/NIOSH
- Calibration Services

## Products

- [Product Catalog - Sound Level Meters, Noise Dosimeters and Vibration Meters](https://noisemeters.com/cat): Complete product catalog including doseBadge, LiveNoise and NoiseAPI products.
- [Sound Level Meters for Noise Monitoring from NoiseMeters Limited](https://noisemeters.com/cat/sound-level-meters): Sound level meter product catalog for occupational and environmental noise monitoring.
- [Noise Dosimeters for Occupational Noise Assessments](https://noisemeters.com/cat/noise-dosimeters): doseBadge and personal sound exposure meters for OSHA workplace compliance.
- [Noise Monitors for Environmental, Community and Industrial Applications](https://noisemeters.com/cat/noise-monitors): Portable and installed noise monitoring systems including SoundEar and LiveNoise.
- [doseBadge Noise Dosimeter for Measuring Occupational Noise - OSHA, MSHA, ACGIH and NIOSH](https://noisemeters.com/product/cr/dosebadge): doseBadge product page for OSHA, MSHA and NIOSH compliant occupational noise measurement.

## Applications & Industries

- [Noise and Vibration Monitoring Applications](https://noisemeters.com/applications): Overview of occupational, environmental and industrial noise monitoring applications.
- [Sound Level Meters for Occupational Noise Measurement](https://noisemeters.com/applications/occupational): Occupational noise measurement solutions for OSHA compliance and workplace safety.
- [Sound Level Meters for Environmental Noise Surveys and Community Noise Assessments](https://noisemeters.com/applications/environmental): Type 1 and Type 2 meters for environmental noise surveys with LAeq and statistical parameters.
- [Monitoring Systems and Sound Level Measurement for Construction Noise](https://noisemeters.com/applications/construction): Construction site noise monitoring systems, portable and fixed measurement equipment.
- [Noise Warning and Sound Level Control for Clubs, Bars and Entertainment Venues](https://noisemeters.com/applications/entertainment): Noise control solutions for entertainment venues using SoundEar and Sentry products.
- [Noise in Hospitals and Neonatal Units](https://noisemeters.com/applications/hospital-noise): SoundEar noise warning signs for hospitals and neonatal units.
- [Neighbor Noise - Monitoring and Recording Noise from Neighbors](https://noisemeters.com/applications/neighbour-noise): Neighbor noise monitoring and recording equipment for noise nuisance documentation.
